data.text:
Ravi Shanker Pandey vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 6 August,
2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad 
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:126766
Court No. - 5
Case :- Writ - A No. - 11142 of 2024
Petitioner :- Ravi Shanker Pandey 
Respondent :- State Of Up And 2 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashok Kumar Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble J.J. Munir,J. 
The petitioner, who is a Senior Assistant, posted with the establishment of the Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, Ballia has been transferred vide the impugned order dated 30.06.2024 from Ballia to Maharajganj in public interest. 
Mr. A. K. Pandey, learned Counsel for the petitioner has argued that the transfer order is in violation of the State's Transfer Policy of 11.06.2024 because the petitioner is due to retire in eleven months time, which is within two years and clause-5 of the transfer policy mandates that such personnel are not to be disturbed. 
The violation of the State's Transfer Policy howsoever gross is not a ground for this Court to issue a writ. Nevertheless, violation of the State's Transfer Policy is alleged by the petitioner, which they ought to adhere to. The petitioner has already represented in the matter to the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, U. P., Lucknow vide his representation dated 29.06.2024, which Ravi Shanker Pandey vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 6 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102056325/
1 has been duly recommended by the Assistant Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, Ballia. 
In the circumstances, the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, U. P., Lucknow is ordered to decide the petitioner's representation dated 29.06.2024 within a week of receipt of a copy of this order in accordance with the State's Transfer Policy and communicate the result to the petitioner within three days of recording his decision. 
This petition is disposed of in terms of the aforesaid orders. 
Let this order be communicated to the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, U. P.,
Lucknow through the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Lucknow by the Registrar (Compliance) within 48 hours. 
Order Date :- 6.8.2024 Vijay  Ravi Shanker Pandey vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 6 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102056325/
2
